children.name: Purchase cards update price, savings badge and action by navigat
children.text:
Purchase cards update price, savings badge and action by navigating between matched states. The expanded frequency menu opens closed 30 / 60 / 90-day selections. Subscribe → mini-cart → cart → payment is linked. Fallback and no-subscription checkout are standalone test cases.
18 requested frames + 6 frequency-selection prototype frames.

children.name: FRD gap fixes detail
children.text:
FR-3.3 — one-time cart line items now offer 'Switch to subscription'. Applied to the Canvas variants only; the Brushes variants are left without it to represent a non-eligible product, since the requirement scopes conversion to eligible products.
FR-2.7 — frame 04 added as a dedicated 'product not eligible' state, previously shared with the eligibility-timeout frame 03.
FR-3.4 — frame 10 adds the missing checkout Review step, carrying the recurring billing disclosure into step 3.
FR-4.2 / FR-4.5 — resolved by separating the two moments. Frame 07 is suppression only: Affirm disabled, no error. Frame 08 is the blocking case: Affirm was chosen with a one-time cart, then a subscription item was added, so Affirm is selected, the error shows and Continue is blocked. New variants added: Affirm/Selected and Credit-Debit Card/Default.
Frames renumbered into flow order: PDP 01–04, cart 05–06, checkout 07–10, post-purchase 11–12, prototype 13.
